title: Energize
coreMove: Choose one physical support that makes the next focus block easier to enter and sustain.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar frames Energize around using the body to recharge the brain through movement, sleep, food, caffeine, recharge, and modest body-default changes.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The wrong generic version turns the material into health optimization. The specific move is to make a small physical choice that supports attention for the Highlight and Laser block.
sourceAnchorsNote: source contains no named anecdote for this chapter

examples: generic office worker walking at lunch
parent trying to exercise before work

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: prevents the timestamp+named-protagonist template from dominating the chapter

exampleSpecs.domain: a court stenographer preparing for a three-hour deposition transcript review
exampleSpecs.audience: a precision worker who treats fatigue as a moral problem
exampleSpecs.stakes: a name error remains in the record if attention drops after lunch
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she moves the heavy lunch order aside, chooses a lighter meal before review, and schedules a ten-minute courthouse stair loop as the Energize support for the transcript block
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a transcript page with three similar surnames circled in pencil

exampleSpecs.domain: a winter road dispatcher managing plow assignments through midnight
exampleSpecs.audience: an operations worker whose focus depends on sleep and caffeine timing
exampleSpecs.stakes: a missed plow route leaves a hill untreated before school traffic
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he delays the second caffeine bottle until the 10:30 route audit, sets a short nap alarm before the storm peak, and treats those choices as support for the assignment board
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a salt-route board dotted with blue magnets under fluorescent light

exampleSpecs.domain: a pediatric speech therapist preserving energy for afternoon evaluations
exampleSpecs.audience: a clinician whose best attention gets spent before the most delicate session
exampleSpecs.stakes: a child's evaluation notes blur if the therapist arrives depleted
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, she fills the lunch gap with paperwork; after, she walks the clinic courtyard, eats before the session, and starts the evaluation with recharge already built in
exampleSpecs.firstImage: picture-card prompts lined up beside a small audio recorder

exampleSpecs.domain: a jewelry appraiser inspecting estate diamonds under magnification
exampleSpecs.audience: a specialist who needs steady attention for small visual differences
exampleSpecs.stakes: a flawed appraisal changes an inheritance split
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she predicts the second hour will be the danger point, adds a movement reset between trays, and compares the inspection accuracy before and after the reset
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a black velvet tray holding three labeled diamond packets

exampleSpecs.domain: a wildfire logistics planner rebuilding a crew rotation board
exampleSpecs.audience: a planner who mistakes endurance for attention
exampleSpecs.stakes: a crew gets double-booked if the rotation board is edited while depleted
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after a double-booking, she traces the error to skipped food and no recharge, then makes the snack crate and shaded walk part of the next board update
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a soot-smudged crew rotation board propped against a folding chair

exampleSpecs.domain: a music mastering engineer preparing final playback decisions
exampleSpecs.audience: an audio professional whose ears and attention fatigue together
exampleSpecs.stakes: the final master ships with harsh high end if he reviews while drained
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he marks the point where caffeine stopped helping yesterday, takes a silent walk before the final playback, and returns to the console for one Energize-supported pass
exampleSpecs.firstImage: two waveform peaks frozen above a pair of nearfield monitors
